They also want to calculate the cost from the first airport in the available list to the last airport in the same list on the last day of October 2024 (i.e., 2024-10-31) in business class. Provide estimated total payable amount.

We need to do several steps:

1. Get list of all airports: list_all_airports() -> returns list of airports. We need the first and last airport codes.

2. Compute flight cost: get_flight_cost(travel_from=first_airport_code, travel_to=last_airport_code, travel_date="2024-10-31", travel_class="business") -> returns cost in USD.

3. Then we need to estimate total payable amount. That might include flight cost plus maybe insurance? But user didn't mention insurance. They just want estimated total payable amount. So likely it's just flight cost.

But they also said "arrange a flight on booking id 1234 as soon as possible". That implies we might need to book a flight using book_flight. But we don't have access token yet. We need to authenticate first. But we don't have client credentials. We can call travel_get_login_status to see if logged in. But we don't know how to get access token. Possibly we can skip actual booking and just provide cost estimate. The user specifically asked for estimated total payable amount. So we can compute cost and give that.

Thus we need to call list_all_airports, then get_flight_cost. Let's do that.
